charts.title: TOI-4342 c: orbits around TOI-4342
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-4342's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-4342 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Tey et al. 2023 (2023AJ....165...93T), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname TEY_ET_AL_2023): P 10.688716 d

charts.title: TOI-4342 c: its transit
charts.description: TOI-4342 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (101, 102, 103) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 354944123, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 10 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 16 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 11-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 10 min early; 11-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 5 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
